Your timeline, in plain words.

Astrological interpretations, not guaranteed outcomes.

TAJIKA CORE BETA

How this forecast is made

Annual charts are cast when the sidereal Sun returns to its birth longitude. Monthly charts are cast at the next 30-degree steps. Muntha advances the birth ascendant by one sign per completed solar year.

The future outlook scans ten years from the chosen date. It selects only unusually consequential event candidates with support in annual and solar-month return charts. Months without selected events stay hidden.

The leading headlines are the highest-ranked significant turning-point candidates. Partial KP timing support or disagreement is displayed. Their dates are approximate solar-month windows, not exact event dates. The short wording is an interpretation, not a factual promise.

What is included

Solar returns, monthly returns, annual Muntha, selected planet-in-house rules and geometric Tajika aspects with planetary orbs. Whole-sign houses and an approximate Lahiri adjustment are used. The selected residence is held fixed for all future return charts.

What is not included yet

This is a core subset, not a complete classical Varshaphala reading. Year-lord election, Panchavargiya Bala, sahams, dashas and the full sixteen yogas are not implemented. Aspects are not tested for application, separation or eventual perfection. Ranking weights and modern wording are editorial choices.

Independent reference validation is pending. Numerical return times are solved closely within this engine, but that does not establish ephemeris accuracy or prediction accuracy. Astrology is not a scientifically validated way to establish future facts.

Major past turning points

There is no fixed quota. Up to ten candidates from age 12 are shown, and zero is allowed. Attendance at school or college, routine exams, routine raises, normal expenses, minor arguments and everyday work pressure are excluded. A completed major qualification is a distinct candidate type. Age only excludes inappropriate event types; it never supplies evidence.

Stronger Tajika matches require two relevant life areas to agree in both annual and monthly charts and distinct supporting evidence. Exploratory matches use a broader threshold and must have at least partial stellar-period support; they are less reliable. These stricter thresholds are editorial heuristics, not validated probabilities or proof that the specific event occurred.

Event types include marriage, a major qualification, first substantial job, first child, major career and income changes, an independent venture becoming significant income, a severe financial disruption, an unplanned loss of a settled home, or a sustained relationship breakdown affecting home life. Each comes with strict match criteria and explicit exclusions. The engine does not invent a medical crisis, bereavement or other dramatic event to make the reading seem personal.

The KP timing check uses the Moon’s nakshatra, star and sub divisions and Vimshottari major/sub periods. It currently uses approximate Lahiri longitudes and whole-sign natal houses. It does not calculate KP ayanamsa, Placidus cusps, cusp sub-lord promises, node agency or ruling planets. Agreement with Tajika is not independent validation or a probability. Only completed past monthly periods from age 12 count. Future candidates cover ten years and exclude one-time firsts when prior life status is unknown. Historic residence is unknown, so past charts use the birthplace. Feedback does not change the fixed calendar claims. This is not a controlled accuracy test.

Sources & privacy

Calculation and interpretation references: Balabhadra’s Hāyanaratna, translated by Martin Gansten, chapters 1, 3, 5 and 8. Astronomical positions: Astronomy Engine.
